boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented KU library environments for quiet reading, group work, research, media work, and focused coursework.

cards.entity_name: Watson Library Third Floor Study Space
cards.title: Watson Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Watson Library • 1425 Jayhawk Blvd.
cards.notes: Set up here when your work needs a computer workstation, study carrel, or FitDesk; reservable study rooms and Studio K are also on this floor.
cards.short_summary: A flexible Watson floor for computer-based work, carrels, group study, and FitDesks.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries identifies Watson’s third floor as having group study space, computer workstations, FitDesks, silent study in the stacks, and reservable study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Use during Watson Library open hours. Study rooms require an online reservation; quiet-designated areas follow the library noise policy.

cards.entity_name: Watson Library Fourth Floor Study Space
cards.title: Watson Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Watson Library • 1425 Jayhawk Blvd.
cards.notes: Choose this floor for individual or small-group reading and writing; keep conversations out of the designated quiet areas and use lower-volume group space.
cards.short_summary: Quiet individual and group study space on Watson’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries lists quiet individual and group study space and silent study in the stacks on Watson Library’s fourth floor.
cards.access_notes: Use during Watson Library open hours. KU Libraries designates Watson fourth-floor quiet-study areas; conversation and phone use are not permitted there.

cards.entity_name: Watson Library Fifth Floor Study Space
cards.title: Watson Library Fifth Floor
cards.subtitle: Watson Library • 1425 Jayhawk Blvd.
cards.notes: Bring reading, drafting, or other solo work to the fifth floor, where quiet study sits alongside International Collections and Gothic-window views.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Watson study floor with International Collections nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries identifies Watson’s fifth floor as quiet individual study space and notes its International Collections and Gothic-window views.
cards.access_notes: Use during Watson Library open hours. The fifth floor is a designated quiet-study area, where conversation and phone use are not permitted.

cards.title: Studio K
cards.subtitle: Watson Library, Third Floor
cards.notes: Reserve this production-ready room when a class presentation, speech, or demonstration needs a quick recording; confirm availability before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A Watson recording studio for independently capturing course presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries describes Studio K as a quick-record studio where users can begin recording a speech, demonstration, or presentation shortly after arrival.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces, Study Rooms, & Policies | KU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Watson’s third floor. Priority use goes to students, staff, or faculty using its video-recording equipment; check the reservation calendar.

cards.entity_name: Anschutz Library Second Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Anschutz Library Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Anschutz Library • 1301 Hoch Auditoria Dr.
cards.notes: Use the second floor for solo reading or laptop work when you need a quieter setting; bring headphones and keep calls for designated cell zones.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study space in KU’s Anschutz Library.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries states that Anschutz Library’s second floor has quiet study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Use during Anschutz Library open hours. Quiet-study areas do not permit conversation or phone use under the KU Libraries noise policy.

cards.entity_name: Anschutz Library Third Floor Group Study Space
cards.title: Anschutz Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Anschutz Library • 1301 Hoch Auditoria Dr.
cards.notes: Bring a project team here for work near computer workstations, printing, and scanning; reserve a room if your group needs a closed-door setup.
cards.short_summary: A group-work floor with computers, printing, and scanning.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries says Anschutz’s third floor has group study spaces, computer workstations, printing, and scanning.
cards.access_notes: Use during Anschutz Library open hours. Group study is allowed outside designated quiet areas; reservable rooms have separate booking rules.

cards.title: David Beaham Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Anschutz Library, Fourth Floor
cards.notes: Choose this named reading room for concentrated reading and solo computer work; use a carrel or table and keep the room quiet for others.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet reading room with tables, carrels, power, and wireless access.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries identifies the David Beaham Reading Room on Anschutz’s fourth floor as a quiet study room for reading and solo computer work, with carrels, tables, power outlets, and wireless access.
cards.access_notes: Located on the east portion of Anschutz’s fourth floor; use during library open hours and follow quiet-study expectations.

cards.entity_name: Murphy Art & Architecture Library Study Rooms
cards.title: Murphy Art & Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Level 1, Spencer Museum of Art • 1301 Mississippi St.
cards.notes: Reserve a study room for coursework while working near art, architecture, design, and urban-planning collections; verify the current library schedule first.
cards.short_summary: Reservable academic study rooms within KU’s art and architecture library.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries states that study rooms at the Murphy Art & Architecture Library are available to support academic study and research.
cards.source_title: Murphy Art & Architecture Library | KU Libraries
cards.access_notes: The library is on the first level of the Spencer Museum of Art. KU Libraries says it is open to any on-site user; confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Joe and Joyce Hale Media Center
cards.title: Joe and Joyce Hale Media Center
cards.subtitle: Gorton Music & Dance Library, Murphy Hall Room 240
cards.notes: Use a media workstation for digital score editing, audio, or video work; ask at circulation for in-library headphones or MIDI keyboards.
cards.short_summary: A KU-patron media workspace with Windows PCs, Macs, and in-library equipment checkout.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries says the Joe and Joyce Hale Media Center has eight Windows PCs and two Macs, with software including Sibelius, MuseScore, GarageBand, and Xcode.
cards.source_title: Music and Dance Library Media Facilities | KU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in the Gorton Music & Dance Library. The media-center computers are for KU patrons; headphones and MIDI keyboards are available at the circulation desk.

cards.title: Spahr Engineering Library
cards.subtitle: LEEP2 • 1536 W. 15th St.
cards.notes: Use this LEEP2 library for individual or collaborative engineering coursework; book a group room through KU email or contact Engineering Student Success.
cards.short_summary: Engineering-library study space with group rooms and affiliate desktop workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: KU Libraries states that Spahr Engineering Library includes individual and collaborative study spaces, group study rooms, and desktop computer workstations for School of Engineering affiliates.
cards.access_notes: Located in LEEP2. Reserve group rooms through a KU email account or the Engineering Student Success office; desktop-computer access is limited to Engineering affiliates.
